eps.o: Tyrannis holds the world's first democratic elections, which is a terrible idea; Deliria finds a new way to antagonize the gods.
Shlub wants boba and mobilizes an army; Tyrannis prepares for his demigod ceremony on Mount Olympus.
A baby arrives in a basket; Deliria encroaches on Apollo's turf; Tyrannis throws a potluck.
Shlub's Endless Wine, Cheese and Pita Festival causes a famine; Stupendous and Deliria have a girls' weekend.
Deliria and Shlub must win over the king and queen of another city so Deliria can become its goddess; Tyrannis receives dating advice from Viscera.
Tyrannis gets a new girlfriend whose job becomes a problem for him; Deliria and Hippocampus deal with a Plague.
Shlub has a gambling problem; Tyrannis and Stupendous set off to sea.
Shlub has to improvise a gift for Deliria after forgetting their anniversary; Tyrannis and Stupendous try to cheer up Hippocampus after a break-up.
Tyrannis and his siblings enter a contest; Shlub and Deliria go to a play and she hates it.
A determined child enlists Stupendous to track down her father's killer; Tyrannis agrees to engage in a game of deception for Viscera.
Tyrannis offends his father; Stupendous and Hippocampus do security; Deliria builds a dog.
Krapopolis is invaded; the gods call Deliria's bluff.
Deliria can't get her family to sit still for just one nice picture.
